name: PDFtoMarkdown.ai MCP
description: Converts local PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, HTML, and EPUB files into clean, structured Markdown (headings, tables, OCR text) through the PDFtoMarkdown.ai API, exposed as a convert_pdf_to_markdown tool for MCP clients.

PDFTOMARKDOWN_API_KEY.description: PDFtoMarkdown.ai API key from https://pdftomarkdown.ai/account (free tier available).
